title: Tôi bị lạc: asking for directions when lost

segments.script: [EN: Quick review. Say more, or add —] [PAUSE 4s] [VI: thêm] [PAUSE 0.5s] [EN: Say a little, or less —] [PAUSE 4s] [VI: ít] [PAUSE 0.5s] [EN: Say ice —] [PAUSE 4s] [VI: đá] [PAUSE 0.5s] [EN: Say today —] [PAUSE 4s] [VI: hôm nay] [PAUSE 0.5s] [EN: Say tomorrow —] [PAUSE 4s] [VI: ngày mai] [PAUSE 0.5s] [EN: Say yesterday —] [PAUSE 4s] [VI: hôm qua] [EN: Good.]

[EN: Listen.] [PAUSE 0.5s] [VI: Dạ, tôi bị lạc.] [PAUSE 0.5s] [VI_F: Dạ, đường này. Quẹo trái.] [PAUSE 0.5s] [VI: Dạ, cảm ơn chị.] [PAUSE 1s] [EN: You said] [VI: tôi bị lạc] [EN: it means I'm lost. Listen to its three parts.] [VI_F: tôi] [EN: is] [EN: a flat tone, no mark] [PAUSE 0.3s] [VI_F: bị] [EN: has] [EN: a low tone, cut off short] [PAUSE 0.3s] [VI_F: lạc] [EN: also has] [EN: a low tone, cut off short] [EN: . Listen to the whole phrase again.] [VI_F: tôi bị lạc] [PAUSE 1s] [VI_F: tôi bị lạc] [EN: Now you say it.] [PAUSE 4s] [VI: tôi bị lạc] [EN: Good.] [PAUSE 0.5s] [EN: Next,] [VI: đường này] [EN: means this street. Here] [VI: đường] [EN: means street, or road — a different word from] [VI: đường] [EN: sugar, that you already know.] [PAUSE 0.3s] [VI_F: đường] [EN: has] [EN: a falling tone] [PAUSE 0.3s] [VI_F: này] [EN: also has] [EN: a falling tone] [EN: . Listen to the whole phrase again.] [VI_F: đường này] [PAUSE 1s] [VI_F: đường này] [EN: Now you say it.] [PAUSE 4s] [VI: đường này] [EN: Good.] [PAUSE 0.5s] [EN: Last,] [VI: quẹo trái] [EN: means turn left. Listen to its two parts.] [VI_F: quẹo] [EN: has] [EN: a low tone, cut off short] [PAUSE 0.3s] [VI_F: trái] [EN: you know — it has] [EN: a high, rising tone] [EN: . Listen to the whole phrase again.] [VI_F: quẹo trái] [PAUSE 1s] [VI_F: quẹo trái] [EN: Now you say it.] [PAUSE 4s] [VI: quẹo trái] [EN: Good.]

[EN: Quick pass over today's words.] [PAUSE 0.5s] [EN: I'm lost —] [PAUSE 4s] [VI: tôi bị lạc] [PAUSE 0.5s] [EN: This street —] [PAUSE 4s] [VI: đường này] [PAUSE 0.5s] [EN: Turn left —] [PAUSE 4s] [VI: quẹo trái] [EN: Good.]

[EN: Let's drill. I'm lost —] [PAUSE 4s] [VI: tôi bị lạc] [PAUSE 0.5s] [EN: This street —] [PAUSE 4s] [VI: đường này] [PAUSE 0.5s] [EN: Turn left —] [PAUSE 4s] [VI: quẹo trái] [PAUSE 0.5s] [EN: Now say it. Say you're lost —] [PAUSE 4s] [VI: Tôi bị lạc.] [PAUSE 0.5s] [EN: Say turn left on this street —] [PAUSE 4s] [VI: Đường này, quẹo trái.] [PAUSE 0.5s] [EN: Now reverse. I say the Vietnamese, you say the English.] [PAUSE 0.5s] [VI_F: tôi bị lạc] [PAUSE 3s] [EN: I'm lost] [PAUSE 0.5s] [VI_F: đường này] [PAUSE 3s] [EN: this street] [PAUSE 0.5s] [VI_F: quẹo trái] [PAUSE 3s] [EN: turn left] [PAUSE 0.5s] [EN: One last time, before we move on.] [PAUSE 0.5s] [VI_F: tôi bị lạc] [PAUSE 1s] [VI_F: đường này] [PAUSE 1s] [VI_F: quẹo trái] [PAUSE 0.5s] [EN: Remember,] [VI: bị] [EN: has] [EN: a low tone, cut off short] [EN: , and] [VI: lạc] [EN: also has] [EN: a low tone, cut off short] [EN: .]

[EN: Listen again — now you understand it.] [PAUSE 0.5s] [VI: Dạ, tôi bị lạc.] [PAUSE 0.5s] [VI_F: Dạ, đường này. Quẹo trái.] [PAUSE 0.5s] [VI: Dạ, cảm ơn chị.] [PAUSE 1s] [EN: Your turn. Say you're lost.] [PAUSE 4s] [VI: Tôi bị lạc.] [EN: Good.] [PAUSE 0.5s] [EN: Now say turn left —] [PAUSE 4s] [VI: Quẹo trái.] [EN: Well done.] [PAUSE 0.5s] [EN: Next lesson, finding a pharmacy. One word to start —] [VI: thuốc] [EN: it means medicine. See you then.]
